title: [Interview Request] AI and Game Narrative Design
author: HelicopterNo9899
selftext:
My name is Don. I'm a video journalist creating Ground Zero, a series about AI asset/tool guides for indie developers. Future Videos feature: Why solo developers should use Midjourney, Making Simple Game Assets | Easy | Midjourney - 2024, and more.

I'm currently producing an episode about AI and narrative design. If possible, I would love to interview one of you and discuss your work flow/experiences. This episode would be specifically about Game narratives problems, highlighted by there endings and AI potential in this realm.

Would any of you be interested in being part of this video? It could be as simple as answering a list of questions I send you here on Reddit.

Thanks for your time,

Don
